summary: `auth login` must refuse a captured JWT that has already expired instead of saving it, and must leave the stored session untouched.
reason: The cookie sources return whatever they have on file -- a stale browser profile, or an old press-auth capture -- and a Concur JWT lasts about an hour. Login printed "OK Found 2 cookies" and overwrote the stored session with a dead one, so the failure only surfaced as HTTP 401 on the next, unrelated command.
validated_outcome: go build, go vet and go test ./... pass. Unit tests cover JWT expiry parsing (padded and unpadded payloads, missing exp, malformed tokens) and the age wording. A command-level test imports an expired Cookie header and asserts exit code 4, nothing saved, and an already-stored working session left byte-for-byte unchanged; it fails with the check removed. Found live: a browser profile whose token had expired two days earlier was imported as "Session saved".
